notes: Single paid Muse pilot: reinterpret a 5-by-5 upper section of the Warcraft II Grunt reference as the original WarConquer Marches axe soldier. Higher resolution illustration, never pixel art. One API request, no paid retries.

jobs.unit_description: Original WarConquer Marches axe infantryman, HUMAN ex-woodsman of the border, large repaired haft of his axe; patched oxblood wool, soot-dark armor, weathered leather straps, dark oak, patinated copper and memory-ribbons. Never resemble a Warcraft orc; preserve our exact WarConquer concept design.
jobs.pose_notes: The first reference is an approximately 5 by 5 arrangement from the top of a classic Grunt animation sheet: follow its cell order, head/body orientation, weight shifts and arm/leg movement, but substitute an original human Marches axe warrior. Carefully keep weapon in the same anatomical hand and maintain a stable ground anchor. No illustration tiles are allowed to resemble the original Warcraft character.
